items.originalTitle: Sergio Perez praises Colton Herta impact - but has no say over 2027 Cadillac F1 team-mate choice
items.summaryEn: Sergio Perez has signed a new Cadillac contract running through 2029 ahead of the Mexican Grand Prix, and he insisted he will have no say over the team's 2027 team-mate choice while praising Colton Herta's impact.
detailZh: 佩雷兹称赞科尔顿·赫塔带来的影响，但对2027年凯迪拉克F1车队队友人选没有发言权
佩雷兹在墨西哥主场大奖赛前签下新合同，本站第一节练习中科尔顿·赫塔将接手瓦尔特利·博塔斯的赛车
瓦尔特利·博塔斯，凯迪拉克；塞尔吉奥·佩雷兹，凯迪拉克
佩雷兹在墨西哥大奖赛前签下新合同后强调，他对凯迪拉克F1车队2027年的队友人选没有发言权。
这位墨西哥车手在重返罗德里格斯兄弟赛道前已确认获得至2029年的发车位，这场比赛也将是他的第300场F1比赛——去年离开红牛后，他一直在场边观战。
但现任队友瓦尔特利·博塔斯的未来远未确定；尽管这位芬兰人否认他在新加入的凯迪拉克车队的位置有危险，但车队领队马尔钦·布德科夫斯基在美国大奖赛上发言时拒绝确认这两位现任车手下赛季将保持不变。
储备车手科尔顿·赫塔将在墨西哥站第一节练习中代替博塔斯出场，他目标是达到获得国际汽联超级驾照所需的积分，从而能够参加F1比赛。
这位美国人今年从印地赛车转投F2，尽管在Hitech车队遇到困难，但他此前在美国的成绩意味着他可以通过练习赛出场达到门槛。
在谈到赫塔在车队首个赛季中的贡献时，佩雷斯表示：“我认为他做得很好。他为车队带来了良好的反馈和有用的信息，这正是我们所需要的。”
“参加第一节自由练习总是很难展现出你的速度或你的水平。但现在我认为他在赛车和模拟器上有了更多时间，所以我们开始看到更多他的速度。”
“显然，这不是我的决定，但我认为这将由马尔钦来决定他们想要谁坐进赛车。我和瓦尔特里也合作得很好。我认为他在几场比赛中非常不走运。在奥斯汀，他展现了非常强劲的速度，所以对车队来说这不是一个容易的决定。”
关于他的新合同，佩雷斯提到了帮助一支F1新军所带来的额外动力，以及他的职责超越了“尽可能开得快”这一事实。
但当被问及这是否包括参与讨论谁应在2027年成为他的搭档时，他回答说：“不，完全没有。”
“我也不想参与，因为那不是我的决定。这就是为什么我们有像马尔钦这样的人，他会审视所有数据和信息，最终根据他认为对车队未来最有利的判断来做出决定。”
“显然，我们正处于一个需要极速发展的时期。接下来的三四个月对我们的准备工作至关重要。所以，是的，我认为这取决于他。”
detailEn: Sergio Perez praises Colton Herta impact - but has no say over 2027 Cadillac F1 team-mate choice
Sergio Perez signed a new contract ahead of his home race in Mexico, where Colton Herta will take over Valtteri Bottas' car in FP1
Valtteri Bottas, Cadillac, Sergio Perez, Cadillac
Sergio Perez has insisted he will have no say on his Cadillac Formula 1 team-mate for 2027 after signing a new contract ahead of the Mexican Grand Prix.

The Mexican's spot on the grid was confirmed through to 2029 ahead of his return to the Autodromo Hermanos Rogriguez - which will also mark his 300th F1 race - having watched on from the sidelines last term following his departure from Red Bull.

But the future of current team-mate Valtteri Bottas is far from certain; though the Finn denies that his place with the debutant Cadillac squad is in danger, team principal Marcin Budkowski refused to confirm the incumbent duo would remain unchanged next season when speaking at the United States GP.
Reserve driver Colton Herta will run in FP1 in place of Bottas in Mexico as he aims to register the requisite tally of points to earn an FIA superlicence, which would allow him to compete in F1.
The American switched to F2 from IndyCar this year and, despite struggles with Hitech, his previous results Stateside mean he can meet the threshold through practice running.

Addressing Herta's contribution to the team during its maiden campaign, Perez said: "I think he's doing a good job. He's bringing good feedback to the team and good information, which is all we need from him.
"Doing FP1s is always very difficult to show your speed or the level you're at. But now I think he's having more time in the car and in the simulator, so we're starting to see more of his speed.

"Obviously, it's not my decision, but I think it will be down to Marcin to decide who they want in the car. I'm also working really well with Valtteri. I think he's been very unfortunate in a few races. In Austin, he showed very strong pace, so there isn't an easy decision for the team."
Regarding his new contract, Perez alluded to the extra motivation of helping an upstart team in F1 and the fact that his duties surpass "driving as fast as possible".
But asked whether this included being involved in the discussions over who should be his partner for 2027, he replied: "No, not at all.

"I don't want to, either, because that's not my decision. That's why we have someone like Marcin, who will be looking at all the data and information, and he will ultimately make that decision based on what he thinks is best for the future of the team.
"Obviously, we're in a period where we need to evolve extremely quickly. The next three or four months are really crucial in our preparation. So, yeah, I think it's down to him."

items.originalTitle: Why “ignorance is a superpower” for Kimi Antonelli, according to Daniel Ricciardo
items.summaryEn: Daniel Ricciardo believes Kimi Antonelli's age and innocence are what have made him so successful in the 2026 Formula 1 season. With nine victories so far in his sophomore campaign, the Mercedes driver can clinch his maiden world title in Sunday's Mexican Grand Prix with a ninth-place finish, or if neither George Russell nor Lewis Hamilton wins.
detailZh: 里卡多：安东内利的“无知”是超能力
里卡多认为，在安东内利接近首个F1冠军之际，这位年轻人的年龄是一大优势
里卡多认为，安东内利的年龄与单纯是他在2026赛季F1取得如此成功的原因。
安东内利在个人第二个F1赛季已取得九场胜利，这让他来到首个世界冠军的边缘。这位梅赛德斯车手只需在周日的墨西哥大奖赛获得第九名，或者拉塞尔与汉密尔顿均未获胜，即可加冕。
这将使这位20岁的车手成为F1史上最年轻的世界冠军，比塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔目前的纪录提前三年多。
里卡多22岁完成F1首秀、35岁从世界锦标赛退役，他相信自己完全清楚安东内利的感受——以及这种感受为何让他如此强大。
“前几天有个朋友问我关于基米·安东内利的事，我说‘无知是一种超能力’——你知道，我真正想说的是‘年轻’，我完全不是在贬低他，”这位澳大利亚人在《Beyond The Grid》播客中说道。“年轻是一种超能力，无知、没有过多接触世界和诸如此类的事物。
“我记得我在红牛车队的头一年；你天真、年轻、无知。我不知道，一切都轻松，一切都来得容易，就是那种‘哦哇，我在赢，酷，我就继续赢下去吧，因为我是最棒的’。”
里卡多在同胞马克·韦伯退役后，于2014赛季加入红牛主队，与塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔搭档；他出人意料地包揽了车队当年的全部三场胜利，表现明显优于这位卫冕四届世界冠军。
丹尼尔·里卡多驾驶红牛赛车小红牛10，领先于驾驶红牛赛车小红牛10的塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔
安东内利今年超越拉塞尔的方式与当年有着明显的相似之处，尽管这位英国车手是梅赛德斯既定的明星。
“我无意拿自己与他作比较之类的，但在某些情况下，这项运动和这个世界都可能非常紧张激烈，年轻自有其力量，而随着岁月流逝，你只会不断积累包袱……”里卡多继续说道。
“现在我觉得他正处于那个绝佳的状态：他显然非常有天赋、非常快，但还没有真正背上任何包袱，所以就像是在说，咱们就去比赛吧。外面没什么杂念，这是一种超能力。”
“随着年复一年，这对我来说变得困难得多。甚至包括2018年离开红牛的决定……这些事情，你显然会去质疑，而随着时间推移，就会想‘我并没有真正找到成功，或者没有达到我设想的样子’。这些事情不断冒出来。‘那个决定对吗？现在我做了这个，那对吗？’
“再次强调，这是许多事情的累积，我觉得到最后我必须挖得很深才能找到某些东西，而以前那很容易——我其实不用多想，它就在那里。”
在美国大奖赛夺冠后，安东内利承诺将在本赛季剩余时间里坚持自己的理念，无论即将到来的加冕如何。
“我会以同样的心态去面对，只是尽量享受比赛，希望争取再赢一场，”他说，“但最好是以强势表现收官，这就是目标。从现在起，我只想好好享受赛季剩下的比赛。”
detailEn: Why “ignorance is a superpower” for Kimi Antonelli, according to Daniel Ricciardo
Daniel Ricciardo sees Kimi Antonelli’s age as a major advantage as the youngster nears his maiden F1 title
Daniel Ricciardo believes Kimi Antonelli’s age and innocence is what has made him so successful in the 2026 Formula 1 season.

Nine victories so far in his sophomore F1 campaign have taken Antonelli to the brink of his maiden world title. All the Mercedes driver needs to be crowned in Sunday’s Mexican Grand Prix is ninth place, or for neither George Russell nor Lewis Hamilton to win.
This would make the 20-year-old F1’s youngest-ever champion, beating Sebastian Vettel’s current record by more than three years.
Ricciardo, who made his F1 debut at 22 years old and retired from the world championship at 35, believes he knows exactly how Antonelli feels – and how that makes him so strong.

“I got asked by a friend about Kimi Antonelli the other day, and I said ‘ignorance is a superpower’ – you know, ‘being young’ is what I’m really trying to say, I’m not trying to be mean to him at all,” the Australian told the Beyond The Grid podcast. “Being young is a superpower, being ignorant and not having been so exposed to the world and things like that.

“I remember my first year at Red Bull Racing; you’re naive, you’re young, you’re ignorant. I don’t know, everything’s easy and it comes easy, and it’s just, ‘Oh wow, I’m winning, cool, I’ll just keep winning, cause I’m the best’.”

Ricciardo joined Red Bull’s main squad for the 2014 season following compatriot Mark Webber’s retirement, teaming up with Sebastian Vettel; he unexpectedly took all three of the outfit’s victories that year, noticeably outperforming the reigning four-time world champion.
Daniel Ricciardo, Red Bull Racing RB10, leads Sebastian Vettel, Red Bull Racing RB10
There is an obvious parallel with the way Antonelli has surpassed Russell this year despite the Briton being Mercedes’ established star.

“I don’t mean to compare myself to him or anything, but the power of being young in some situations where this sport and the world can be very intense, and over the years you’re just going to accumulate baggage…” Ricciardo continued.

“Right now I think he’s at that sweet spot where he’s obviously very talented, very fast, but he hasn’t yet really acquired any baggage, so it’s like, let’s just go and race. There’s nothing really going on out there, which is a superpower.

“That became a lot harder for me as the years went on. Even obviously the decision in 2018 to move on from Red Bull… These things, you obviously question them, and as years go on, it’s like ‘I haven’t really found success or maybe how I’d pictured it to go’. These things keep popping up. ‘Was that decision right? Now I’ve done this, is that right?’
“Again, an accumulation of many things, and I think by the end I had to dig very deep to find something where before it was just easy – I didn’t really have to think, it was just there.”
After winning the United States GP, Antonelli pledged to maintain his philosophy for the remainder of the season, regardless of his impending coronation.

“I'm going to approach it with the same mindset, just trying to have as much fun as possible, trying to hopefully fight for another win,” he said. “But it would be best to finish on a high, and that's the goal. I'm just going to try to enjoy the rest of the season from now on.”

安东内利正处于个人第二个F1赛季。
keyPointsEn: Antonelli is in his sophomore F1 campaign.
